answer: A farm faking 158 aliases needs 158 separate administration histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Probate practitioner licence with estate administration history is the check: estates administered under one licence for years. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The pearl record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the tide entry is checkable by anyone, and the forge window closes before a farm can catch up.
